applicabilityBasis.summary: United Stables markets U for payments and settlement at approximately USD 1.00 per token. Eligible Mint Users receive issuer-selected equivalent-notional cash or stablecoins on redemption; secondary Holding Users must first become Mint Users. Payment applicability is apparent, not a finding that these discretionary asset-redemption terms satisfy the statutory monetary-value definition.

references.label: United Stables current terms: mint-user redemption policy

genius.notes: United Stables states $U has not obtained registration, authorization, or licensing under the GENIUS Act. Its active U.S./EU/Hong Kong geofencing and KYB restrictions are issuer distribution policy, not proof that the GENIUS statutory DASP prohibition is currently operative. The general DASP deadline is distinct from Act effectiveness and foreign lawful-order conditions. The monthly-report hub publishes independent accountant reports: the August 31 2026 reserves report has a Moore CPA Limited ISAE 3000 limited-assurance conclusion signed September 11 2026, not merely an issuer-signed reserve schedule. The conclusion has valuation/custody/credit/liquidity limitations and is not a finding of GENIUS-compliant reserve assets. Current July 27 terms permit issuer-selected cash or stablecoin redemption only for approved Mint Users. No U.S. authorization pathway or foreign exception is inferred from the report.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: On October 7 2026 the issuer explicitly disclaims GENIUS authorization and the checked public primary federal/state materials and targeted issuer searches yielded no United Stables Limited/U approval, official application, state qualification or foreign registration. This dated, bounded negative-evidence conclusion is not proof that a nonpublic filing cannot exist. SCRC state comparability procedures and ordinary state licensing are not issuer authorization or foreign registration.
